title: Golconda and Charminar zones restaurant special enforcement drive
authority: TG SAFE (Commissioner of Food Safety, Telangana)
summary: Twenty-two TG SAFE enforcement teams comprising Food Safety Officers and Police inspected 22 major food establishments across the Golconda and Charminar zones. Fourteen FSSAI licences were suspended with operations ordered to stop immediately due to severe hygiene violations, cockroach and fly infestations, rat droppings, and rotten or fungus-infested vegetables. Show-cause notices were issued to eight establishments, including Taj Falaknuma Palace, Golconda Hotel and Resorts, and Pista House Shahalibanda. Enforcement teams discarded approximately 544 kg of spoiled and contaminated food alongside 13 kg of repeatedly reused cooking oil.

title: Pre-Diwali sweets manufacturing units special enforcement drive across CURE region
authority: TG SAFE (Commissioner of Food Safety, Telangana)
summary: TG SAFE Food Safety Officers and Hyderabad Police inspected 16 sweet manufacturing and retail units across the Core Urban Region ahead of Diwali. Officials seized and discarded 3,546.5 kg of unhygienic, expired, or mislabelled food articles valued at approximately ₹16.86 lakh. Five units were ordered to close down for operating without valid FSSAI licences or under severe unhygienic conditions, five FSSAI licences were suspended, and show-cause notices were issued to several others. Over 3,133 kg of sub-standard food articles worth ₹15.03 lakh were seized from G. Pulla Reddy Sweets in Sanath Nagar alone.

title: CURE Region sweets manufacturing and retail special enforcement drive
authority: TG SAFE (Commissioner of Food Safety, Telangana)
summary: TG SAFE Food Safety Officers inspected 21 sweet manufacturing and retail units across the Core Urban Region and collected 21 samples on suspicion of adulteration. Officials seized 1,035 kg of food articles valued at ₹7,75,850. Three FSSAI licences were suspended, seven show-cause notices were issued, six improvement notices were proposed, and one unlicensed establishment was ordered closed. The drive reported pests, expired or mislabelled food, improper storage, dirty walls and damaged floors, clogged drains, greasy exhausts, uncovered sweets, missing protective clothing, and missing mandatory records across inspected units.
